```dockerfile
# Stage 1: deps
FROM node:20-alpine AS deps
WORKDIR /app
COPY package*.json ./
RUN npm ci --ignore-scripts

# Stage 2: build
FROM node:20-alpine AS build
WORKDIR /app
COPY --from=deps /app/node_modules ./node_modules
COPY . .
RUN npx tsc --noEmit false \
 && npm prune --omit=dev

# Stage 3: runtime
FROM node:20-alpine AS runtime
ENV NODE_ENV=production
WORKDIR /app

RUN addgroup -S app && adduser -S app -G app

COPY --from=build --chown=app:app /app/dist ./dist
COPY --from=build --chown=app:app /app/node_modules ./node_modules
COPY --from=build --chown=app:app /app/package.json ./package.json

USER app
EXPOSE 3000
CMD ["node", "dist/index.js"]
```

Key moves:

| Choice | Why |
|--------|-----|
| `alpine` base | ~5MB vs ~900MB full Debian |
| Separate `deps` stage | Layer cache — code change no re-`npm ci` |
| `npm ci` not `install` | Lockfile-exact, faster, no write to `package-lock.json` |
| `npm prune --omit=dev` | Strip devDeps before copy to runtime |
| Only copy `dist/` + pruned `node_modules` | No src, no `.ts`, no test files in final image |
| Non-root user | Security. Alpine needs `addgroup`/`adduser` not `useradd` |

Assume `tsconfig.json` has `"outDir": "./dist"`. Adjust `CMD` path if entry point differ.
